stage: After source discovery/review and passage selection, before native predictions; development diagnostic, not held-out or pre-discovery preregistration.

contrast: Notice position only. Same exact four passage strings, questions and response schema in both conditions. No label definitions reordered.
model: Existing pinned Qwen3-4B Q8_0 and llama.cpp v09 assets; no fallback or training

generation.overflow_action: Reject before prediction; no truncation or on-output editing

evaluation: Strict duplicate-key-free JSON, exact question order/fields/enums; compare reference exposure/value or agreement and sufficient evidence IDs. Format failure, truncation, missing response or invalid evidence retained as failures. No repairs. Report each of three questions per condition, not a population accuracy estimate.
boundary: Not a full-source reader, historical prefix, natural correction-core replay or comparison against the annotated support adapter.
